## Learn through experiments

Try the [interactive bond-pricing lesson](finance/fixed-income/bond-pricing.qmd). Change a bond's yield and see how its price responds.

## How lessons are written

Each lesson begins with a **specific problem** and uses one consistent example before introducing terminology, equations, implementation details, and wider applications. Pages are works in progress; new chapters will be added gradually.
